player_prompt.intro:
A kɔyɔm {player_id} ɓɛɛ German Whist.
{phase_info}
A ɓɛɛ {hand_size} kārtu.
Kɛɛlɛ kārtu ɓɛɛ '[play N]', ɓɛɛ N ɓɛɛ ɗɛɛ a kɔyɔm (ɓɛɛ ɓɛɛ '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: Kәrma-a kǝratǝbe: kam fandoma so dǝye kaadi firtin dәga gojin kuru am gәnyiya do kart fuwunna sәdin. Kaudiwa suro kәnda adǝn waratazayin sodә, daraja ro isayiyin ba.
player_prompt.phase_playing: Kәla kәndobe dәn, shi gәnatәdә bannazǝna. Tartibdo ndusoye sәdin suro loktu adәben kambo kǝnasarro faidatin.

next_card.playing_phase: Kat ba dǝ sadinba - sa bisketǝye baditǝna.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fasal kǝndotǝye ba. '[play N]' faidatә kart nth suro muskonnǝmben bisketaro.
invalid_move.bad_position: Na kәrtube adә ba. Nyiye kaudo {hand_size} dәga gozayin.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Nyiye diwal dǝga kǝltǝ kuru kaadi {lead_suit} yeyi sәdin.

trick.won_learning: Kɔyɔm {winner_id} kɛɛlɛ kɔɔlɛ ɓɛɛ {card} ɓɛɛ kɛɛlɛ kārtu kɛɛnɛŋɛ.

phase.learning_complete: Kәla dәga fandobe dǝ zauro bannazǝna. Sa fuwutǝ kǝrabedә dawono - awowa kalkallo gәnyi so kәnasar ro faidatin.

draw.winner_received: Nyiye kasudu dәn kәnasarratә kuru {card} gowotә.
draw.loser_received: Nyiye trick dǝga koltǝ kuru {card} dә daga gattǝna.

trick_view.empty: Kawuwa adәma so dә ro biske ba.
